$comment: Source of truth for the numbers shown in profile/README.md. Every figure carries its definition and where it is measured. Change a number here first, then run: python scripts/check_ecosystem.py

repertorium.freshness: snapshot with a known state date, not a live stream

boutique.license: per entry (MIT / Apache-2.0 for our connectors)

repertorium_documents_pl.definition: Polish law documents in the Repertorium PL corpus edition

repertorium_documents_eu.definition: EU law documents in the Repertorium corpus

repertorium_links_pl_eu.definition: links between Polish and EU documents in the PL-EU bridge

connectors.definition: MCP connector entries in the Boutique catalogue: 44 connectors to legal sources plus boutique-mcp, the catalogue itself

jurisdictions.definition: distinct jurisdictions covered by connectors: 34 countries plus EU law. legalize-mcp alone spans 32 jurisdictions, most of them also covered by a national connector, so it adds no separate count
jurisdictions.measured_in: catalog.json entries[type=konektor].jurisdiction, excluding the meta labels 'Whole fleet' and '32 jurisdictions'

skills_catalogue.definition: skills published as downloadable cards in the Boutique catalogue (Polish and English)

skills_hub_pl.definition: SKILL.md files in awesome-matematic-skills-pl, including the developer bundle dev-mcp

patron_editions.definition: Windows installer editions built from one code line: PL, EN, US, GB, BR, IT, DE, ES, FR

patron_sources_pl_eu.definition: Polish and EU legal source connectors bundled in the PATRON installer (the installer ships 20 connector servers in total, 13 of them national ELI connectors)
patron_sources_pl_eu.measured_in: patron scripts/bundle-mcp.cjs and the site gate konektory-liczba-gate.py

connector_source_documents.definition: documents reachable at the public sources the connectors query live; these are NOT stored by us and are not part of Repertorium
connector_source_documents.measured_in: boutique page proof card, state 2026-07-10, rounded down
